```{r}
# Data prep
plants <- data |>
  mutate(Plant_Health_Status = factor(Plant_Health_Status,
                                      levels = c("Healthy", "Moderate Stress", "High Stress"))) |>
  arrange(Plant_ID, date) |>
  group_by(Plant_ID) |>
  mutate(across(Soil_Moisture:Electrochemical_Signal, lag, .names = "{.col}_prev")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  drop_na() |>
  select(-Timestamp, -date)

set.seed(202)
shuffled <- sample(1:10)

train <- plants |> filter(Plant_ID %in% shuffled[1:8])
valid <- plants |> filter(Plant_ID == shuffled[9])
test  <- plants |> filter(Plant_ID == shuffled[10])

```


```{r}
#Models
null_model <- multinom(Plant_Health_Status ~ 1, data = train, trace = FALSE)
full_model <- multinom(Plant_Health_Status ~ . - Plant_ID, data = train, trace = FALSE)

forward_aic <- MASS::stepAIC(null_model, scope = formula(full_model),
                             direction = "forward", k = 2, trace = 0)
backward_bic <- MASS::stepAIC(full_model, direction = "backward",
                              k = log(nrow(train)), trace = 0)
```

```{r}
forward_aic |> tidy()
```

```{r}
backward_bic |> tidy()
```

```{r}
#Scoring Models
get_predictions <- function(model, new_data) {
  predict(model, newdata = new_data, type = "probs") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(truth = new_data$Plant_Health_Status,
           predicted = predict(model, newdata = new_data))
}

plant_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, precision, recall, f_meas, roc_auc, pr_auc)

results <- bind_rows(
  forward_aic  |> get_predictions(valid) |> mutate(model = "Forward AIC",  set = "Validation"),
  backward_bic |> get_predictions(valid) |> mutate(model = "Backward BIC", set = "Validation"),
  forward_aic  |> get_predictions(test)  |> mutate(model = "Forward AIC",  set = "Test"),
  backward_bic |> get_predictions(test)  |> mutate(model = "Backward BIC", set = "Test")
)

results |>
  group_by(set, model) |>
  plant_metrics(truth, Healthy:`High Stress`, estimate = predicted, estimator = "macro") |>
  select(set, model, .metric, .estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)
```

```{r}
results |>
  filter(set == "Test", model == "Backward BIC") |>
  conf_mat(truth, predicted) |>
  autoplot(type = "heatmap")
```
```{r}
#| label: cross-validation
cv_fold <- function(plant) {
  fold_train <- train |> filter(Plant_ID != plant)
  fold_test  <- train |> filter(Plant_ID == plant)

  null_model <- multinom(Plant_Health_Status ~ 1, data = fold_train, trace = FALSE)
  full_model <- multinom(Plant_Health_Status ~ . - Plant_ID, data = fold_train, trace = FALSE)

  fold_aic <- MASS::stepAIC(null_model, scope = formula(full_model),
                            direction = "forward", k = 2, trace = 0)
  fold_bic <- MASS::stepAIC(full_model, direction = "backward",
                            k = log(nrow(fold_train)), trace = 0)

  bind_rows(
    fold_aic |> get_predictions(fold_test) |>
      mutate(model = "Forward AIC", n_vars = length(fold_aic$coefnames) - 1),
    fold_bic |> get_predictions(fold_test) |>
      mutate(model = "Backward BIC", n_vars = length(fold_bic$coefnames) - 1)
  ) |>
    mutate(held_out_plant = plant)
}

cv_results <- shuffled[1:8] |> map(cv_fold) |> list_rbind()

cv_results |>
  group_by(model) |>
  plant_metrics(truth, Healthy:`High Stress`, estimate = predicted, estimator = "macro") |>
  select(model, .metric, .estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)
```

```{r}
cv_results |>
  distinct(held_out_plant, model, n_vars) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = n_vars)
```
## Final model

$$
\log\frac{P(\text{Moderate})}{P(\text{Healthy})} = 20.16 - 0.480\,\text{Moisture} - 0.148\,\text{Nitrogen}
$$

$$
\log\frac{P(\text{High})}{P(\text{Healthy})} = 29.93 - 0.776\,\text{Moisture} - 0.249\,\text{Nitrogen}
$$

The final model is a multinomial logistic regression with healthy being the baseline class. Each equation gives the log-odds of a stress level relative to healthy. Higher soil moisture and nitrogen both shift a plant toward being healthy, with stronger effects for high stress than for moderate stress.
